OUR LITTLE CLASSROOMS

Art Studio

Make a little mess. Make something yours.

Make a shape collage

Ages 3–825 min

Tear, arrange and layer colourful paper to make a picture that is entirely your own.

Mixing Colours

Ages 4–720–30 minutes

Predict paint mixtures, record your results, match colour cards and invent your own shade.

What this room is for

The Art Studio is about making choices, not perfect pictures: tear or cut coloured paper, arrange it, layer it, then mix your own shades from red, yellow and blue washable paint. Both activities here — Make a shape collage and Mixing Colours — need nothing more than paper, a glue stick and paints you probably already have.

How one session runs

Spread a table cover first, put out the materials, and let your child lead while you narrate what you notice: “you tore that strip so small”, “the red and yellow made orange”. Every activity has a printable or on-screen sheet with drawing space, so the results can go on the wall, not in the bin.
